selection: Uniform without replacement: 128 retained rows per ensemble; repeated parameter states retained; no likelihood filtering.
method: Selected retained rows, equal weight; repeated states retained. Pointwise quantiles after linear interpolation in Muv and log10(phi) on contiguous finite native LF segments.
missing_policy: No extrapolation. Bands shown only where all selected rows are finite; otherwise null.
interpretation: Empirical 16-84% sample range; not a validated credible interval or simultaneous band.
